cautions.en: No public price list found for any Wolters Kluwer compliance/legal product; enterprise sales is quote-only.

capabilities.en: Compliance Intelligence: AI-powered monitoring of global regulatory bodies, summarizing proposed changes, guidance, and enforcement actions with red-lined updates.
A portfolio of separate legal/regulatory products (VitalLaw, Legisway, Kleos, TyMetrix 360, ELM Solutions) rather than a single tool.

limitations.en: 'Wolters Kluwer' is a corporate umbrella, not one product; a prospective buyer must pick a specific solution (e.g. Compliance Intelligence, Legisway) before pricing or scope can be evaluated.
No self-serve trial or public pricing; all engagement goes through enterprise sales.

reason.en: Overlaps for contract/e-signature workflows offered within the Wolters Kluwer legal portfolio.

unknowns: The catalogue entry treats 'Wolters Kluwer' as a single tool, but it is actually a multi-brand conglomerate; which specific product (Compliance Intelligence, Legisway, VitalLaw, etc.) the fiche should describe is unresolved.
No pricing figures found anywhere, official or third-party.
conflicts: Seed pricingText claims 'À partir de 49€/mois' but no source on the official domain confirms any public monthly price; this figure could not be verified and is not carried into pricing.plans.
